gen-megrim-gf-sofia-sans: Megrim draws hairline-thin angular letters with a bent-paperclip c that feels pulled from a future film. Sofia Sans backs it with plain sans lowercase, tall and sturdy.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-sulphur-point: Mystery Quest has open jaws on every curve, like an old storybook. Sulphur Point follows with chunky, marker-steady lowercase, a flat stripe of ink beside the heading's low-slung ascenders.
gen-tourney-fs-technor: Tourney stretches out its wide-tracked, athletic capitals. Technor sits beneath in glowing neon-tube lines, cool and geometric, with generous openings into every bowl, so the heading's muscle meets a plain sans that stays light.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-sn-pro: SN Pro reads open and modern, its curves leaving generous apertures throughout. Oswald packs its rows tight and confident above it, and that squeeze against breathing room is what the pair does best.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-ysabeau-sc: Red Hat Display draws every line like a marker, with daylight visible inside each curve. Ysabeau SC takes over below with a sans c that gapes wide at any size, giving the bold heading a looser neighbor.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-almarai: Chubbo's letters look drawn with a marker tip, every bend smooth and unobstructed. Almarai follows in a sans-serif whose line never swells or tapers, and its friendly, unpinched shapes are the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-vend-sans: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, with lowercase that rises high and paper showing through its stenciled gaps. And Vend Sans does the opposite job, a ruler-straight sans whose wide terminals and full x-height keep text easy to follow.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans has an x-height rising close to cap height and a spacious c, so lines look modern and open. Luckiest Guy just shouts, cheerfully, in one poured weight.
gen-megrim-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condensed: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed reads clean, with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and big entrances into each curve. Megrim adds angular, futuristic edges above it.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans reads modern and tall, its rounded letters each leaving one side clearly open. Unica One shares that single stroke thickness, so heading and text feel cut from the same stencil sheet.
